tests.scenario: User navigates from root hub to experiments/spatial-media/
tests.expectation: The page displays Lumina Spatial Gallery branding with high-fidelity visionOS aesthetic.

tests.scenario: User opens page on Meta Quest 3 or Android device with AR support.
tests.expectation: The 'In Development' or 'Enter XR' button correctly detects XR support and shows the relevant message/notice.

tests.scenario: User clicks the Back link on the Lumina page.
tests.expectation: The user returns to the Experiments Hub correctly.

tests.scenario: User enters XR session and observes sample.png.
tests.expectation: The image plane uses the 16-bit depth.png to recede in 3D space, showing visible volume and 'diorama' depth.

tests.scenario: Examine the edges of the spatial photo plane.
tests.expectation: Edges should blend softly into the environment (no hard geometric lines), matching the visionOS benchmark.

tests.scenario: Pinch index and thumb in front of the spatial photo.
tests.expectation: The console should log 'Hand Pinch START' and the hand controller (if used) should provide a 20ms haptic pulse.

tests.scenario: Move the immersion slider in the landing page UI.
tests.expectation: When in XR, the background sky opacity should dim or darken, transitioning from Passthrough (0.0) to Immersive (1.0).
